source.text: Καὶ προσελθόντες οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ Σαδδουκαῖοι πειράζοντες ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν σημεῖον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπιδεῖξαι αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: And having come the Pharisees and Sadducees testing asked him a sign out of the heaven to show them.

en.L: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, they asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to show them a sign from heaven.
en.B: Pharisees and Sadducees came to put Jesus to the test. They asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to show them a sign from heaven.
en.R: Some Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus. They wanted to trap {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. So they asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to show them a sign from heaven to prove that God had sent {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y se acercaron los fariseos y saduceos y, para ponerlo a prueba, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pidieron que les mostrara una señal del cielo.
es.B: Unos fariseos y saduceos vinieron a poner a prueba a Jesús. Le pidieron que les mostrara una señal del cielo.
es.R: Unos fariseos y saduceos se acercaron a Jesús. Querían atraparlo. Así que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pidieron que les mostrara una señal del cielo para probar que Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} había enviado.

fr.L: Et les Pharisiens et les Sadducéens s’approchèrent et, pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mettre à l’épreuve, ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandèrent de leur montrer un signe venant du ciel.
fr.B: Des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens vinrent pour mettre Jésus à l’épreuve. Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandèrent de leur montrer un signe venant du ciel.
fr.R: Des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens sont venus voir Jésus. Ils voulaient {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} prendre au piège. Alors ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont demandé de leur montrer un signe venant du ciel, pour prouver que Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avait envoyé.

sw.L: Na Mafarisayo na Masadukayo walikuja, na wakimjaribu, wakamwomba awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.
sw.B: Mafarisayo na Masadukayo walikuja ili kumjaribu Yesu. Wakamwomba awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.
sw.R: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo walimjia Yesu. Walitaka kumtega. Basi wakamwomba awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni kuthibitisha kwamba Mungu ndiye aliyemtuma.

vi.L: Và những người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê đến, và để thử {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, họ xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ xem một dấu lạ từ trời.
vi.B: Những người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê đến để thử Đức Giê-xu. Họ đòi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ xem một dấu lạ từ trời.
vi.R: Có mấy người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê đến gặp Đức Giê-xu. Họ muốn gài bẫy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì vậy họ đòi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm một dấu lạ từ trời để chứng tỏ rằng Đức Chúa Trời đã sai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến.

ko.L: 그리고 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들이 다가와서 그분을 시험하며, 하늘로부터 오는 표적을 자기들에게 보여 달라고 그분께 요구했다.
ko.B: 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들이 예수를 시험하려고 와서, 하늘로부터 오는 표적을 보여 달라고 요구했다.
ko.R: 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들 몇이 예수께 왔다. 그들은 예수를 함정에 빠뜨리려고 했다. 그래서 하나님께서 예수를 보내셨다는 것을 증명할 표적을 하늘에서 보여 달라고 했다.

decisions.choice: the Pharisees and Sadducees: two rival groups acting together
decisions.reason: The Sadducees were the priestly leaders in Jerusalem and denied the resurrection (22:23); the Pharisees were teachers of the law with a strong following among the people. They differed sharply, but here both oppose Jesus, as in 3:7.

decisions.choice: testing: trying to trap him
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of the devil testing Jesus (4:1, 3). They ask for proof hoping he will fail to give it.

decisions.choice: a sign from heaven: a sign from God, plainly shown
alternatives: a sign in the sky only
decisions.reason: "Heaven" often stands for God. They want an unmistakable sign that God backs Jesus, as in 12:38.

decisions.choice: to prove that God had sent him
decisions.reason: Readable says what the sign was meant to show, as in 12:38.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: A new scene begins, so Balanced and Readable name Jesus.

decisions.choice: spans on separate pronouns (le, lo); none on pronouns joined to the verb (ponerlo, atraparlo)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Spanish joins some object pronouns to the verb and usually leaves the subject pronoun out, so there is nothing separate to capitalise. The setting covers separate pronouns and possessives only, so Spanish has fewer spans than English throughout the passage.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R)
decisions.reason: As in John and Mark: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and as young readers now meet stories. Speech keeps its own tenses at every level.

decisions.choice: les Pharisiens, les Sadducéens, capitalised, at every level
decisions.reason: The style guide's terms for the Gospels and Acts: the names of the groups are capitalised, as in John and Mark, so that they read as names.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on the object prefix -m- (wakimjaribu, wakamwomba)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: The English "him" takes the setting. Swahili carries it in the object prefix -m- of the verb, which cannot take a capital, so the setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives (yeye, wake, nami). Swahili therefore has fewer spans than English throughout the passage.

decisions.choice: "dấu lạ từ trời"; R adds "để chứng tỏ rằng Đức Chúa Trời đã sai Ngài đến"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 8:11 and Matthew 12:38: "dấu lạ" is the style guide's word for sign; Readable says what the sign was meant to prove, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Sa-đu-sê"
decisions.reason: The Protestant transliteration, as in Matthew 3:7 and Mark 12:18.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 16:1-12; the narrative honours Jesus with "께서" and -시-, and Jesus speaks in 해라체
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change (style guide, sections 4 and 7).

decisions.choice: "바리새파 사람들", "사두개파 사람들"; "표적" at every level
decisions.reason: The forms of the Korean Matthew 3:7; "표적" as in the Korean Matthew 12:38 and Mark 8:11, a sign showing God's backing, never simply a "miracle".

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ὀψίας γενομένης λέγετε· Εὐδία, πυρράζει γὰρ ὁ οὐρανός·

records.literal_gloss: He but answering said to them, Evening having come you say, Fair weather, is red for the sky;

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered and said to them, "When evening comes, you say, '[It will be] fair weather, for the sky is red.'
en.B: He answered them, "In the evening you say, 'It will be fine weather, because the sky is red.'
en.R: Jesus answered, "In the evening you say, 'The weather will be good tomorrow, because the sky is red.'

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, respondiendo, les dijo: «Al caer la tarde {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “[Hará] buen tiempo, porque el cielo está rojo”.
es.B: Él les respondió: «Por la tarde {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Va a hacer buen tiempo, porque el cielo está rojo”.
es.R: Jesús les respondió: «Por la tarde {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Mañana va a hacer buen tiempo, porque el cielo está rojo”.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} répondit et leur dit : « Le soir venu, vous dites : “[Il fera] beau temps, car le ciel est rouge.”
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « Le soir, vous dites : “Il va faire beau, parce que le ciel est rouge.”
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Le soir, vous dites : “Il va faire beau demain, parce que le ciel est rouge.”

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akajibu, akawaambia, "Jioni inapofika mnasema, '[Kutakuwa na] hali nzuri ya hewa, kwa maana anga ni jekundu.'
sw.B: Aliwajibu, "Jioni mnasema, 'Hali ya hewa itakuwa nzuri, kwa sababu anga ni jekundu.'
sw.R: Yesu aliwajibu, "Jioni mnasema, 'Kesho hali ya hewa itakuwa nzuri, kwa sababu anga ni jekundu.'

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáp lời và nói với họ: "Khi chiều tối đến, các người nói: '[Trời sẽ] tạnh ráo, vì bầu trời đỏ.'
vi.B: Ngài đáp: "Lúc chiều tối, các người nói: 'Trời sẽ đẹp, vì bầu trời ửng đỏ.'
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Lúc chiều tối, các người nói: 'Ngày mai trời sẽ đẹp, vì bầu trời đỏ.'

ko.L: 그러나 그분이 대답하여 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희는 저녁이 되면 '하늘이 붉으니 날씨가 좋겠다' 하고 말한다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 대답하셨다. "너희는 저녁때에 '하늘이 붉으니 날씨가 맑겠다' 하고 말한다.
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "너희는 저녁때 하늘을 보고 '하늘이 붉으니 내일은 날씨가 좋겠다' 하고 말한다.

decisions.choice: the sayings about the sky in 16:2-3 are present, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: the sayings are missing, so Jesus's answer goes straight to 16:4
decisions.reason: Some important early manuscripts, among them Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, lack the words from "When evening comes" (16:2) to the end of 16:3; most later manuscripts have them. The sayings may have been added from a saying like Luke 12:54-56, or left out by copyists in places where a red morning sky did not mean bad weather. The SBLGNT prints them. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: a red sky at evening: a sign of fair weather next day
decisions.reason: People read the weather from the color of the sky. A red evening sky promised a clear day.

decisions.choice: tomorrow
decisions.reason: Readable says that the evening sky was read as a sign of the next day's weather.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} and every plural "you" in the passage
decisions.reason: Spanish has two plural forms of "you", Latin American "ustedes" (the default) and Peninsular "vosotros"; the setting chooses between them. English has no such choice, so these spans have no English counterpart.

decisions.choice: "các người" for the Pharisees and Sadducees, through 16:2-4
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Jesus speaking to opponents, as in 12:39 and Mark 8:12.

decisions.choice: "하늘이 붉으니 날씨가 좋겠다": the reason comes before the forecast
decisions.reason: Korean puts a reason before what follows from it; nothing is added, so no brackets are needed.

source.text: καὶ πρωΐ· Σήμερον χειμών, πυρράζει γὰρ στυγνάζων ὁ οὐρανός.

records.literal_gloss: And in the morning, Today a storm, is red for being overcast the sky.

en.L: And in the morning, 'Today [there will be] a storm, for the sky is red [and] overcast.'
en.B: And in the morning you say, 'There will be a storm today, because the sky is red and threatening.'
en.R: And in the morning you say, 'There will be a storm today, because the sky is red and dark with clouds.'

es.L: Y por la mañana: “Hoy [habrá] tormenta, porque el cielo está rojo [y] nublado”.
es.B: Y por la mañana {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Hoy va a haber tormenta, porque el cielo está rojo y amenazante”.
es.R: Y por la mañana {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Hoy va a haber tormenta, porque el cielo está rojo y cubierto de nubes oscuras”.

fr.L: Et le matin : “Aujourd’hui, [il y aura] de l’orage, car le ciel est rouge [et] sombre.”
fr.B: Et le matin, vous dites : “Il y aura de l’orage aujourd’hui, parce que le ciel est rouge et menaçant.”
fr.R: Et le matin, vous dites : “Il va y avoir un orage aujourd’hui, parce que le ciel est rouge et plein de nuages sombres.”

sw.L: Na asubuhi, 'Leo [kutakuwa na] dhoruba, kwa maana anga ni jekundu [na] lenye mawingu mazito.'
sw.B: Na asubuhi mnasema, 'Leo kutakuwa na dhoruba, kwa sababu anga ni jekundu na lina dalili mbaya.'
sw.R: Na asubuhi mnasema, 'Leo kutakuwa na dhoruba, kwa sababu anga ni jekundu na lina mawingu meusi.'

vi.L: Và buổi sáng: 'Hôm nay [sẽ có] bão, vì bầu trời đỏ [và] u ám.'
vi.B: Còn buổi sáng các người nói: 'Hôm nay sẽ có bão, vì bầu trời đỏ và u ám.'
vi.R: Còn buổi sáng các người nói: 'Hôm nay sẽ có bão, vì bầu trời đỏ và có nhiều mây đen.'

ko.L: 또 아침에는 '하늘이 붉고 흐리니 오늘은 폭풍이 [불겠다]' 하고 말한다.
ko.B: 또 아침에는 '하늘이 붉고 잔뜩 흐리니 오늘은 폭풍이 불겠다' 하고 말한다.
ko.R: 또 아침에는 '하늘이 붉고 구름이 끼어 어두우니 오늘은 폭풍이 불겠다' 하고 말한다.

decisions.choice: present, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: See the note on 16:2. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: red and overcast: the sky is red and gloomy together
decisions.reason: The participle describes the sky as darkened with clouds while it glows red, a sign of bad weather coming.

decisions.choice: you say
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat "you say" from 16:2, which the Greek leaves understood.

decisions.choice: [불겠다]; "말한다" without brackets
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "today a storm"; Korean needs a verb, which Literal brackets. "말한다" carries on the "you say" of 16:2 and is not bracketed, since Korean must repeat it to close the quotation.

source.text: τὸ μὲν πρόσωπον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ γινώσκετε διακρίνειν, τὰ δὲ σημεῖα τῶν καιρῶν οὐ δύνασθε.

records.literal_gloss: The indeed appearance of the sky you know to discern, the but signs of the times not you are able.

en.L: You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but the signs of the times you are not able [to discern].
en.B: You know how to read the face of the sky, but you cannot read the signs of the times.
en.R: You know how to understand what the sky is telling you. But you cannot understand the signs of what God is doing in your own time.

es.L: El aspecto del cielo {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} discernir, pero las señales de los tiempos no {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} [discernir].
es.B: {{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} interpretar el aspecto del cielo, pero no {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} interpretar las señales de los tiempos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} entender lo que el cielo {{plural_you:les|os}} dice. Pero no {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} entender las señales de lo que Dios está haciendo en {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} propio tiempo.

fr.L: Vous savez discerner l’aspect du ciel, mais les signes des temps, vous ne le pouvez pas.
fr.B: Vous savez lire le visage du ciel, mais vous êtes incapables de lire les signes des temps.
fr.R: Vous savez comprendre ce que le ciel vous annonce. Mais vous ne pouvez pas comprendre les signes de ce que Dieu fait à votre époque.

sw.L: Mnajua kupambanua sura ya anga, lakini ishara za nyakati hamwezi [kuzipambanua].
sw.B: Mnajua kusoma sura ya anga, lakini hamwezi kusoma ishara za nyakati.
sw.R: Mnajua kuelewa anga linawaambia nini. Lakini hamwezi kuelewa ishara za kile ambacho Mungu anafanya katika wakati wenu wenyewe.

vi.L: Các người biết phân biệt sắc diện của bầu trời, nhưng các dấu hiệu của thời đại thì các người không thể [phân biệt].
vi.B: Các người biết đọc nét mặt của bầu trời, nhưng không đọc được các dấu hiệu của thời đại.
vi.R: Các người biết hiểu những gì bầu trời cho thấy. Nhưng các người không thể hiểu những dấu hiệu cho thấy Đức Chúa Trời đang làm gì trong thời của các người.

ko.L: 너희는 하늘의 모양은 분별할 줄 알면서, 때의 표적들은 [분별할] 수 없다.
ko.B: 너희는 하늘의 낯빛은 분별할 줄 알면서, 이 시대의 표적은 분별하지 못한다.
ko.R: 너희는 하늘을 보고 날씨를 알 줄 안다. 그러나 하나님께서 지금 이 시대에 하시는 일을 보여 주는 표적은 깨닫지 못한다.

decisions.choice: the signs of the times: what God is doing now through Jesus
decisions.reason: Jesus's works were the signs they asked for and did not see (11:2-6; 12:28). "Times" means the appointed time God has brought.

decisions.choice: no opening word of address, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: "Hypocrites!" at the start, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts begin this sentence with "Hypocrites!" The sentence belongs to the passage that some early manuscripts lack (16:2). Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the signs of what God is doing in your own time
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the times", following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: face of the sky
decisions.reason: The Greek word means face or appearance; Balanced keeps the picture of reading a face.

decisions.choice: "các dấu hiệu của thời đại" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Here the Greek word for sign is used of what can be read in events, set beside the weather signs; "dấu hiệu" (indication) suits that reading better than "dấu lạ" (a sign shown by God), which 16:1 and 16:4 keep for the sign they demand. Readable says what the signs show (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "때의 표적들" (L); "이 시대의 표적" (B); "하나님께서 지금 이 시대에 하시는 일을 보여 주는 표적" (R)
decisions.reason: The signs are what God is doing now through Jesus (meaning decision), so the word is "표적", as in 16:1 and 16:4, linking Jesus's answer to their demand.

source.text: Γενεὰ πονηρὰ καὶ μοιχαλὶς σημεῖον ἐπιζητεῖ, καὶ σημεῖον οὐ δοθήσεται αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ τὸ σημεῖον Ἰωνᾶ.

records.literal_gloss: A generation evil and adulterous a sign seeks, and a sign not will be given to it except the sign of Jonah.

en.L: An evil and adulterous generation seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah."
en.B: An evil, unfaithful generation goes looking for a sign, but the only sign it will be given is the sign of Jonah."
en.R: The people of today are evil and are not faithful to God. They ask for a sign. But no sign will be given to them except the sign of Jonah."

es.L: Una generación malvada y adúltera busca una señal, y no se le dará señal sino la señal de Jonás».
es.B: Una generación malvada e infiel anda buscando una señal, pero la única señal que se le dará es la señal de Jonás».
es.R: La gente de hoy es malvada y no es fiel a Dios. Piden una señal. Pero no se les dará ninguna señal, excepto la señal de Jonás».

fr.L: Une génération mauvaise et adultère recherche un signe, et il ne lui sera pas donné de signe, sinon le signe de Jonas. »
fr.B: Une génération mauvaise et infidèle réclame un signe, mais le seul signe qui lui sera donné, c’est le signe de Jonas. »
fr.R: Les gens d’aujourd’hui sont mauvais, et ils ne sont pas fidèles à Dieu. Ils demandent un signe. Mais aucun signe ne leur sera donné, sauf le signe de Jonas. »

sw.L: Kizazi kiovu na chenye uzinzi kinatafuta ishara, na hakitapewa ishara isipokuwa ishara ya Yona."
sw.B: Kizazi kiovu kisicho mwaminifu kinatafuta ishara, lakini ishara pekee kitakayopewa ni ishara ya Yona."
sw.R: Watu wa siku hizi ni waovu, na si waaminifu kwa Mungu. Wanaomba ishara. Lakini hawatapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ishara ya Yona."

vi.L: Thế hệ gian ác và ngoại tình này đòi một dấu lạ, nhưng sẽ không có dấu lạ nào được ban cho nó, ngoại trừ dấu lạ của Giô-na."
vi.B: Thế hệ gian ác và bất trung này đòi xem dấu lạ, nhưng sẽ không có dấu lạ nào được ban cho họ, ngoài dấu lạ của Giô-na."
vi.R: Người đời nay thật gian ác và không trung thành với Đức Chúa Trời. Họ đòi xem dấu lạ. Nhưng họ sẽ không được thấy dấu lạ nào cả, ngoài dấu lạ của Giô-na."

ko.L: 악하고 음란한 세대가 표적을 구한다. 그러나 요나의 표적 말고는 아무 표적도 그 세대에게 주어지지 않을 것이다."
ko.B: 악하고 하나님께 신실하지 못한 세대가 표적을 찾는다. 그러나 이 세대가 받을 표적은 요나의 표적밖에 없다."
ko.R: 오늘날 사람들은 악하고, 하나님을 저버렸다. 그래서 표적을 보여 달라고 한다. 그러나 요나의 표적 말고는 아무 표적도 받지 못할 것이다."

decisions.choice: the sign of Jonah: as Jesus explained it in 12:39-41
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats his earlier answer. As Jonah came back from the sea creature, the Son of Man will rise from the grave (12:40).

decisions.choice: adulterous: unfaithful to God
decisions.reason: As in 12:39, the prophets call Israel's turning from God adultery (Hosea 2:2; Jeremiah 3:8).

decisions.choice: the sign of Jonah, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: the sign of Jonah the prophet, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "the prophet", as in 12:39. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the wording of 12:39 at each level
decisions.reason: Jesus gives the same answer, so it is given in the same words.

decisions.choice: infidèle (B)
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced "unfaithful": the word pictures unfaithfulness to God (m2). Literal keeps "adultère"; Readable says it plainly. 12:39 has the same answer, and the two should be read in the same words.

decisions.choice: the wording of 12:39 at each level: "thế hệ gian ác và ngoại tình" (L), "bất trung" (B), "người đời nay ... không trung thành với Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats his answer of 12:39 (meaning decision), so each level repeats the Vietnamese of that verse.

decisions.choice: The wording of the Korean Matthew 12:39 at each level
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats the saying of 12:39 (meaning decision), so the Korean repeats the earlier rendering, without the word "prophet", which the Greek leaves out here.

records.literal_gloss: And having left them he went away.

en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} left them and went away.
en.R: Then Jesus left them and went away.

es.B: Entonces los dejó y se fue.
es.R: Entonces Jesús los dejó y se fue.

fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les quitta et s’en alla.
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus les a laissés là et s’en est allé.

vi.L: Và bỏ họ lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi khỏi.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bỏ họ lại và đi khỏi.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu bỏ họ lại và đi nơi khác.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 그들을 남겨 두고 떠나가셨다.

decisions.choice: leaving them: leaving them behind, turning away from them
decisions.reason: The verb means to leave behind. Jesus ends the conversation.

source.text: Καὶ ἐλθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ εἰς τὸ πέραν ἐπελάθοντο ἄρτους λαβεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: And having come the disciples to the other side forgot bread to take.

en.L: And the disciples came to the other side [and] had forgotten to take bread.
en.B: When the disciples reached the other side of the lake, they found that they had forgotten to bring any bread.
en.R: The followers went across to the other side of the lake. But they had forgotten to bring bread.

es.L: Y los discípulos llegaron al otro lado [y] se habían olvidado de tomar panes.
es.B: Cuando los discípulos llegaron al otro lado del lago, se dieron cuenta de que se habían olvidado de llevar pan.
es.R: Los seguidores cruzaron al otro lado del lago. Pero se habían olvidado de llevar pan.

fr.L: Et les disciples, arrivés sur l’autre rive, avaient oublié de prendre des pains.
fr.B: Quand les disciples arrivèrent de l’autre côté du lac, ils s’aperçurent qu’ils avaient oublié de prendre du pain.
fr.R: Les disciples ont traversé le lac et sont arrivés sur l’autre rive. Mais ils avaient oublié d’apporter du pain.

sw.L: Na wanafunzi walipofika ng'ambo, walikuwa wamesahau kuchukua mikate.
sw.B: Wanafunzi walipofika ng'ambo ya ziwa, waligundua kwamba walikuwa wamesahau kuchukua mkate wowote.
sw.R: Wafuasi walivuka kwenda upande wa pili wa ziwa. Lakini walikuwa wamesahau kuleta mkate.

vi.L: Và các môn đồ đến bờ bên kia, [nhưng] đã quên đem theo bánh.
vi.B: Khi các môn đồ qua đến bờ bên kia biển, họ mới biết mình đã quên mang theo bánh.
vi.R: Các môn đồ qua bên kia hồ. Nhưng họ đã quên mang theo bánh.

ko.L: 그리고 제자들이 건너편으로 갔는데, 빵을 가져가는 것을 잊어버렸다.
ko.B: 제자들이 바다 건너편으로 갔는데, 빵을 가져오는 것을 잊어버리고 왔다.
ko.R: 제자들은 호수 건너편으로 건너갔다. 그런데 빵을 가져오는 것을 깜빡 잊었다.

decisions.choice: had forgotten: they forgot before they set out
decisions.reason: They had failed to bring bread when they left, and found it out on the way or on arriving.

decisions.choice: the other side: across the Sea of Galilee
decisions.reason: Jesus had come by boat to the region of Magadan (15:39) and now crosses again.

decisions.choice: of the lake
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what they crossed.

decisions.choice: les disciples at every level, Readable included
decisions.reason: English Readable says "followers"; French "disciple" is a common, transparent word, and the style guide keeps "les disciples" at every level, as in Mark's French. This holds for the whole passage.

decisions.choice: "바다 건너편" (B); "호수 건너편" (R)
decisions.reason: The other side of the Sea of Galilee (meaning decision), with "바다" (B) and "호수" (R) as settled for the Gospels.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ὁρᾶτε καὶ προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.

records.literal_gloss: The and Jesus said to them, Watch and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

en.L: And Jesus said to them, "Watch out and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
en.B: Jesus told them, "Keep your eyes open, and guard yourselves against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
en.R: Jesus said to them, "Be careful! Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

es.L: Y Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} atentos y {{plural_you:cuídense|cuidaos}} de la levadura de los fariseos y saduceos».
es.B: Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} los ojos abiertos y {{plural_you:protéjanse|protegeos}} de la levadura de los fariseos y saduceos».
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado! {{plural_you:Cuídense|Cuidaos}} de la levadura de los fariseos y saduceos».

fr.L: Et Jésus leur dit : « Voyez et gardez-vous du levain des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens. »
fr.B: Jésus leur dit : « Ouvrez l’œil, et méfiez-vous du levain des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens. »
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Faites attention ! Méfiez-vous du levain des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens. »

sw.L: Na Yesu akawaambia, "Tazameni, mjihadhari na chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo."
sw.B: Yesu aliwaambia, "Kaeni macho, na mjilinde dhidi ya chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo."
sw.R: Yesu aliwaambia, "Kuweni waangalifu! Jihadharini na chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo."

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Hãy coi chừng và giữ mình khỏi men của người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu bảo họ: "Hãy cẩn thận! Hãy đề phòng men của người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Các con phải cẩn thận! Hãy coi chừng men của người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê."

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "주의하여 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들의 누룩을 조심하여라."
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "정신을 차리고, 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들의 누룩을 경계하여라."
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "조심하여라! 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들의 누룩을 조심하여라."

decisions.choice: yeast: an influence that spreads through the whole
decisions.reason: A little yeast works through a whole batch of dough (13:33; 1 Corinthians 5:6). Here it is a picture of a harmful influence; 16:12 says what it is.

decisions.choice: the Pharisees and Sadducees: one article for both groups
decisions.reason: As in 16:1, the two groups are treated together.

decisions.choice: leaven (L); yeast (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is the fermented dough kept back to raise the next batch. Literal keeps the older word "leaven"; Balanced and Readable use the everyday "yeast".

decisions.choice: levadura (every level)
decisions.reason: English uses "leaven" at Literal and "yeast" at Balanced and Readable. Spanish "levadura" covers both, and is the word for the picture of an influence that spreads through the whole (meaning decision m1). The same in verses 11 and 12.

decisions.choice: le levain at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark 8:15 and Luke 12:1: English Balanced and Readable say "yeast" because "leaven" is no longer an everyday English word. French "levain" still is ("pain au levain"), and it is exactly the fermented dough the Greek means, while "levure" is modern baker's yeast.

decisions.choice: chachu (every level)
decisions.reason: English uses "leaven" at Literal and "yeast" at Balanced and Readable. Swahili "chachu" is the leaven that works through dough, the picture of an influence that spreads through the whole (meaning decision m1); "hamira" is the bought baking yeast. The same in verses 11 and 12.

decisions.choice: "men" at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark 8:15: Vietnamese has one everyday word for leaven and yeast, so the English difference between the levels does not arise.

decisions.choice: "누룩" at every level
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 8:15 and Matthew 13:33: "누룩" is still the everyday word for a leavening starter and keeps the picture of a little that spreads through the whole (meaning decision).

source.text: οἱ δὲ διελογίζοντο ἐν ἑαυτοῖς λέγοντες ὅτι Ἄρτους οὐκ ἐλάβομεν.

records.literal_gloss: They but were reasoning among themselves saying that Bread not we took.

en.L: And they were discussing among themselves, saying, "[It is] because we did not bring bread."
en.B: They talked it over among themselves and said, "He says that because we brought no bread."
en.R: The followers talked about this among themselves. They said, "He is saying this because we did not bring any bread."

es.L: Y ellos discutían entre sí, diciendo: «[Es] porque no trajimos panes».
es.B: Ellos lo comentaron entre sí y dijeron: «Lo dice porque no trajimos pan».
es.R: Los seguidores hablaron de esto entre ellos. Decían: «Dice esto porque no trajimos pan».

fr.L: Mais ils discutaient entre eux, disant : « [C’est] parce que nous n’avons pas pris de pains. »
fr.B: Ils en discutèrent entre eux et dirent : « Il dit cela parce que nous n’avons pas apporté de pain. »
fr.R: Les disciples en ont parlé entre eux. Ils ont dit : « Il dit cela parce que nous n’avons pas apporté de pain. »

sw.L: Nao wakawa wakijadiliana miongoni mwao, wakisema, "[Ni] kwa kuwa hatukuleta mikate."
sw.B: Walijadiliana wao kwa wao, wakasema, "Anasema hivyo kwa sababu hatukuleta mkate."
sw.R: Wafuasi walizungumza jambo hilo wao kwa wao. Wakasema, "Anasema hivi kwa sababu hatukuleta mkate."

vi.L: Nhưng họ bàn luận với nhau rằng: "[Đó là] vì chúng ta không đem theo bánh."
vi.B: Họ bàn tán với nhau: "Thầy nói vậy vì chúng ta không mang theo bánh."
vi.R: Các môn đồ bàn với nhau về chuyện ấy. Họ nói: "Thầy nói như vậy vì chúng ta đã không mang theo bánh."

ko.L: 그러자 그들은 서로 의논하며 말했다. "우리가 빵을 가져오지 않았기 때문이다."
ko.B: 제자들은 서로 수군거리며 말했다. "우리가 빵을 가져오지 않아서 저렇게 말씀하시는 것이다."
ko.R: 제자들은 자기들끼리 이야기했다. "우리가 빵을 가져오지 않아서 선생님께서 이런 말씀을 하시는 거야."

decisions.choice: because: the disciples explain Jesus's warning to themselves
alternatives: the word only introduces their words, "We brought no bread"
decisions.reason: The small word can introduce speech or mean "because". Either way they think Jesus is talking about the bread they forgot.

decisions.choice: He says that
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the disciples were explaining.

decisions.choice: "Thầy nói vậy" (B, R), with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the subject, as the English does; among themselves the disciples speak of Jesus as their teacher, "Thầy", a noun that takes no setting span. "Chúng ta" includes the speakers' hearers.

decisions.choice: Among themselves the disciples speak in the plain style with "우리", but speak of Jesus with the honorific ("말씀하시는")
decisions.reason: "저희" is the humble form used when speaking to Jesus; here they talk among equals, so "우리", while still honouring their teacher.

source.text: γνοὺς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Τί διαλογίζεσθε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, ὀλιγόπιστοι, ὅτι ἄρτους οὐκ ἐλάβετε;

records.literal_gloss: Having known but Jesus said, Why reason you among yourselves, little-faiths, that bread not you took?

en.L: But Jesus, knowing [this], said, "Why are you discussing among yourselves, you of little faith, that you did not bring bread?
en.B: Jesus knew what they were saying, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Why are you talking among yourselves about having no bread, you who have so little faith?
en.R: Jesus knew what they were saying. He said, "Why are you talking about having no bread? Your faith is so small!

es.L: Pero Jesús, sabiéndo[lo], dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:discuten|discutís}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, gente de poca fe, que no {{plural_you:trajeron|trajisteis}} panes?
es.B: Jesús se dio cuenta de lo que decían, y les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:hablan|habláis}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} de que no {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} pan, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} tan poca fe?
es.R: Jesús sabía lo que estaban diciendo. Les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:hablan|habláis}} de que no {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} pan? ¡Qué poca fe {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}}!

fr.L: Mais Jésus, le sachant, dit : « Pourquoi discutez-vous entre vous, gens de peu de foi, de ce que vous n’avez pas pris de pains ?
fr.B: Jésus savait ce qu’ils disaient, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Pourquoi parlez-vous entre vous de ce que vous n’avez pas de pain, vous qui avez si peu de foi ?
fr.R: Jésus savait ce qu’ils disaient. Il leur a dit : « Pourquoi parlez-vous de ce que vous n’avez pas de pain ? Votre foi est si petite !

sw.L: Lakini Yesu, akijua [hilo], akasema, "Kwa nini mnajadiliana miongoni mwenu, enyi wenye imani ndogo, kwamba hamkuchukua mikate?
sw.B: Yesu alijua walichokuwa wakisema, akasema, "Kwa nini mnazungumza wenyewe kwa wenyewe juu ya kutokuwa na mkate, ninyi wenye imani ndogo hivi?
sw.R: Yesu alijua walichokuwa wakisema. Akasema, "Kwa nini mnazungumza juu ya kutokuwa na mkate? Imani yenu ni ndogo sana!

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu biết [điều đó] và nói: "Hỡi những người ít đức tin, sao các con bàn luận với nhau rằng các con không có bánh?
vi.B: Biết họ đang nói gì, Đức Giê-xu bảo: "Hỡi những người ít đức tin, sao các con lại bàn tán với nhau về chuyện không có bánh?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu biết họ đang nói gì. Ngài nói: "Sao các con lại nói chuyện về việc không có bánh? Đức tin của các con thật nhỏ bé!

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서 [그것을] 아시고 말씀하셨다. "믿음이 작은 사람들아, 어찌하여 너희는 빵이 없다고 서로 의논하느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 그것을 아시고 말씀하셨다. "믿음이 작은 사람들아, 왜 너희는 빵이 없다는 이야기를 서로 하고 있느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서는 제자들이 무슨 이야기를 하는지 아셨다. 그래서 말씀하셨다. "너희는 믿음이 너무 작구나! 왜 빵이 없다는 이야기를 하느냐?

decisions.choice: little faith: trust that gives way under pressure
decisions.reason: As in 6:30, 8:26 and 14:31, the word rebukes disciples whose faith is real but weak. They worry about bread after seeing Jesus feed thousands.

decisions.choice: Jesus knew what they were saying
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out what Jesus knew.

decisions.choice: gente de poca fe
decisions.reason: The Greek is one word, "little-faiths", with no word for men; "gente" keeps it plain, as the English "you of little faith" does.

decisions.choice: "những người ít đức tin" (L, B); "Đức tin của các con thật nhỏ bé" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Matthew wording (8:26), with the key term "đức tin" at every level.

decisions.choice: "믿음이 작은 사람들아" (L, B); "너희는 믿음이 너무 작구나!" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled form of the Korean Matthew (6:30, 8:26, 14:31).

source.text: οὔπω νοεῖτε, οὐδὲ μνημονεύετε τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους τῶν πεντακισχιλίων καὶ πόσους κοφίνους ἐλάβετε;

records.literal_gloss: Not yet do you understand, nor remember the five loaves of the five thousand and how many baskets you took?

en.L: Do you not yet understand, nor remember the five loaves of the five thousand and how many baskets you took up?
en.B: Do you still not understand? Have you forgotten the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
en.R: Do you still not understand? Remember the five loaves of bread that fed five thousand people? Remember how many baskets of leftovers you picked up?

es.L: ¿Todavía no {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}}, ni {{plural_you:recuerdan|recordáis}} los cinco panes de los cinco mil y cuántas canastas {{plural_you:recogieron|recogisteis}}?
es.B: ¿Todavía no {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}}? ¿Ya {{plural_you:olvidaron|olvidasteis}} los cinco panes para los cinco mil, y cuántas canastas llenas {{plural_you:recogieron|recogisteis}}?
es.R: ¿Todavía no {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}}? ¿{{plural_you:Recuerdan|Recordáis}} los cinco panes que alimentaron a cinco mil personas? ¿{{plural_you:Recuerdan|Recordáis}} cuántas canastas de sobras {{plural_you:recogieron|recogisteis}}?

fr.L: Ne comprenez-vous pas encore, et ne vous souvenez-vous pas des cinq pains des cinq mille, et combien de paniers vous avez emportés ?
fr.B: Vous ne comprenez toujours pas ? Avez-vous oublié les cinq pains pour les cinq mille, et combien de paniers vous avez ramassés ?
fr.R: Vous ne comprenez toujours pas ? Vous vous souvenez des cinq pains qui ont nourri cinq mille personnes ? Vous vous rappelez combien de paniers de restes vous avez ramassés ?

sw.L: Bado hamwelewi, wala hamkumbuki mikate ile mitano ya watu elfu tano, na vikapu mlivyokusanya vilikuwa vingapi?
sw.B: Bado hamwelewi? Mmesahau ile mikate mitano kwa ajili ya watu elfu tano, na mlijaza vikapu vingapi?
sw.R: Bado hamwelewi? Mnakumbuka ile mikate mitano iliyolisha watu elfu tano? Mnakumbuka mliokota vikapu vingapi vya mabaki?

vi.L: Các con vẫn chưa hiểu, cũng không nhớ năm cái bánh cho năm nghìn [người], và các con đã lượm được bao nhiêu giỏ sao?
vi.B: Các con vẫn chưa hiểu sao? Các con không nhớ năm cái bánh cho năm nghìn người, và các con đã thu được bao nhiêu giỏ đầy sao?
vi.R: Các con vẫn chưa hiểu sao? Các con có nhớ năm ổ bánh đã đủ cho năm nghìn người ăn không? Các con có nhớ đã nhặt được bao nhiêu giỏ bánh thừa không?

ko.L: 아직도 깨닫지 못하느냐? 빵 다섯 개로 5,000명을 [먹인 일과], 너희가 몇 바구니를 거두었는지 기억하지 못하느냐?
ko.B: 아직도 깨닫지 못하느냐? 빵 다섯 개로 5,000명을 먹였을 때, 너희가 남은 조각을 몇 바구니나 거두었는지 기억하지 못하느냐?
ko.R: 아직도 깨닫지 못하느냐? 빵 다섯 개로 5,000명을 먹인 일을 기억해 보아라. 그때 너희가 남은 조각을 주워 담은 바구니가 몇 개였느냐?

decisions.choice: the five loaves for the five thousand: the feeding in 14:15-21
decisions.reason: Twelve baskets of pieces were left over (14:20).

decisions.choice: baskets: the ordinary carrying baskets of 14:20
decisions.reason: Matthew uses a different word here from the one in 16:10, matching the two feeding stories (14:20; 15:37).

decisions.choice: of leftovers
decisions.reason: Readable says what filled the baskets.

decisions.choice: "giỏ" here, "giỏ lớn" in 16:10
decisions.reason: As in Mark 8:19-20: Jesus names the two different baskets of the two feedings (meaning decision), and Vietnamese keeps them apart as in 15:37.

decisions.choice: "바구니" (kophinos) here, "광주리" (spyris) in 16:10; "5,000명" in figures
decisions.reason: As in the parallel Mark 8:19-20 and the Korean Matthew 15:37: the two feedings have two words for the baskets, which Jesus repeats; large numbers are in figures.

decisions.choice: [먹인 일과]
decisions.reason: The Greek says "the five loaves of the five thousand"; Korean needs a verb to join the loaves to the people, which Literal brackets.

source.text: οὐδὲ τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους τῶν τετρακισχιλίων καὶ πόσας σπυρίδας ἐλάβετε;

records.literal_gloss: Nor the seven loaves of the four thousand and how many large baskets you took?

en.L: Nor the seven loaves of the four thousand and how many large baskets you took up?
en.B: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many large basketfuls you gathered?
en.R: And remember the seven loaves that fed four thousand people? Remember how many big baskets of leftovers you picked up?

es.L: ¿Ni los siete panes de los cuatro mil y cuántos cestos grandes {{plural_you:recogieron|recogisteis}}?
es.B: ¿O los siete panes para los cuatro mil, y cuántos cestos grandes llenos {{plural_you:recogieron|recogisteis}}?
es.R: ¿Y {{plural_you:recuerdan|recordáis}} los siete panes que alimentaron a cuatro mil personas? ¿{{plural_you:Recuerdan|Recordáis}} cuántos cestos grandes de sobras {{plural_you:recogieron|recogisteis}}?

fr.L: Ni des sept pains des quatre mille, et combien de grandes corbeilles vous avez emportées ?
fr.B: Ou les sept pains pour les quatre mille, et combien de grandes corbeilles vous avez ramassées ?
fr.R: Et vous vous souvenez des sept pains qui ont nourri quatre mille personnes ? Vous vous rappelez combien de grandes corbeilles de restes vous avez ramassées ?

sw.L: Wala ile mikate saba ya watu elfu nne, na vikapu vikubwa mlivyokusanya vilikuwa vingapi?
sw.B: Au ile mikate saba kwa ajili ya watu elfu nne, na mlijaza vikapu vikubwa vingapi?
sw.R: Na mnakumbuka ile mikate saba iliyolisha watu elfu nne? Mnakumbuka mliokota vikapu vikubwa vingapi vya mabaki?

vi.L: Cũng không [nhớ] bảy cái bánh cho bốn nghìn [người], và các con đã lượm được bao nhiêu giỏ lớn sao?
vi.B: Hay bảy cái bánh cho bốn nghìn người, và các con đã thu được bao nhiêu giỏ lớn đầy sao?
vi.R: Các con có nhớ bảy ổ bánh đã đủ cho bốn nghìn người ăn không? Các con có nhớ đã nhặt được bao nhiêu giỏ lớn bánh thừa không?

ko.L: 또 빵 일곱 개로 4,000명을 [먹인 일과], 너희가 몇 광주리를 거두었는지도 [기억하지 못하느냐]?
ko.B: 또 빵 일곱 개로 4,000명을 먹였을 때, 남은 조각을 몇 광주리나 거두었는지도 기억하지 못하느냐?
ko.R: 또 빵 일곱 개로 4,000명을 먹인 일도 기억해 보아라. 그때 너희가 남은 조각을 주워 담은 큰 광주리가 몇 개였느냐?

decisions.choice: the seven loaves for the four thousand: the feeding in 15:32-38
decisions.reason: Seven large baskets were left over (15:37).

decisions.choice: large baskets: big hampers, as in 15:37
decisions.reason: The word is used of a basket big enough to lower a man from a wall (Acts 9:25).

decisions.choice: large baskets (L); large basketfuls (B); big baskets (R)
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the difference between the two kinds of baskets.

decisions.choice: cestos grandes (here and 15:37); canastas (verse 9 and 14:20)
decisions.reason: Matthew uses two words for the baskets of the two feedings, the ordinary carrying basket and the large hamper (meaning decision m2). Spanish keeps them apart at every level, as the English "baskets" and "large baskets" do.

decisions.choice: grandes corbeilles (16:10); paniers (16:9)
decisions.reason: As in 15:37 and Mark 8:19-20: each level keeps the difference between the two kinds of baskets with two different French words.

decisions.choice: vikapu vikubwa (here and 15:37); vikapu (verse 9 and 14:20)
decisions.reason: Matthew uses two words for the baskets of the two feedings, the ordinary carrying basket and the large hamper (meaning decision m2). Swahili keeps them apart at every level, as the English "baskets" and "large baskets" do.

decisions.choice: [먹인 일과]; [기억하지 못하느냐]
decisions.reason: The Greek carries the verb "remember" over from 16:9 with "nor"; Korean must repeat it at the end of its own sentence, and Literal brackets it.

source.text: πῶς οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι οὐ περὶ ἄρτων εἶπον ὑμῖν;

records.literal_gloss: How not understand you that not concerning bread I spoke to you?

en.L: How do you not understand that I did not speak to you about bread?
en.B: How can you fail to see that I was not talking to you about bread?
en.R: Why do you not understand that I was not talking about bread?

es.L: ¿Cómo no {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}} que no {{plural_you:les|os}} hablé acerca de panes?
es.B: ¿Cómo es que no {{plural_you:ven|veis}} que no {{plural_you:les|os}} estaba hablando del pan?
es.R: ¿Por qué no {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}} que yo no estaba hablando del pan?

fr.L: Comment ne comprenez-vous pas que ce n’est pas au sujet des pains que je vous ai parlé ?
fr.B: Comment pouvez-vous ne pas voir que je ne vous parlais pas de pain ?
fr.R: Pourquoi ne comprenez-vous pas que je ne parlais pas de pain ?

sw.L: Ni vipi hamtambui kwamba sikuwa nikisema nanyi kuhusu mikate?
sw.B: Mnashindwaje kuona kwamba sikuwa nikizungumza nanyi juu ya mkate?
sw.R: Kwa nini hamwelewi kwamba sikuwa nikizungumza juu ya mkate?

vi.L: Sao các con không hiểu rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không nói với các con về bánh?
vi.B: Sao các con lại không thấy rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không nói với các con về bánh?
vi.R: Tại sao các con không hiểu rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không nói về bánh?

ko.L: 내가 빵에 대하여 너희에게 말한 것이 아님을 어찌하여 깨닫지 못하느냐?
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 한 말이 빵에 관한 것이 아니었음을 어찌 깨닫지 못하느냐?
ko.R: 내가 빵 이야기를 한 것이 아니라는 것을 왜 깨닫지 못하느냐?

decisions.choice: how do you not understand: a rebuke in question form
decisions.reason: Jesus does not expect an answer; he wants them to see the point.

source.text: προσέχετε δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.

records.literal_gloss: Beware but of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

en.L: But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
en.B: Guard yourselves, I say, against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
en.R: Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!"

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:cuídense|cuidaos}} de la levadura de los fariseos y saduceos».
es.B: {{plural_you:Protéjanse|Protegeos}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo, de la levadura de los fariseos y saduceos».
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Cuídense|Cuidaos}} de la levadura de los fariseos y saduceos!».

fr.L: Mais gardez-vous du levain des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens. »
fr.B: Méfiez-vous, je vous le dis, du levain des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens. »
fr.R: Méfiez-vous du levain des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens ! »

sw.L: Lakini mjihadhari na chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo."
sw.B: Nawaambia, jilindeni dhidi ya chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo."
sw.R: Jihadharini na chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo!"

vi.L: Nhưng hãy giữ mình khỏi men của người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê."
vi.B: Ta bảo các con: hãy đề phòng men của người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê."
vi.R: Hãy coi chừng men của người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê!"

ko.L: 오히려 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들의 누룩을 조심하여라."
ko.B: 다시 말한다. 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들의 누룩을 경계하여라."
ko.R: 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들의 누룩을 조심하여라!"

decisions.choice: beware: a command repeating 16:6
decisions.reason: In the SBLGNT this is a new sentence, a fresh command.

decisions.choice: I say
decisions.reason: Balanced marks the repeated warning with "I say" for the force of the Greek "but".

source.text: τότε συνῆκαν ὅτι οὐκ εἶπεν προσέχειν ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν ἄρτων ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ τῆς διδαχῆς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.

records.literal_gloss: Then they understood that not he said to beware of the leaven of the breads but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

en.L: Then they understood that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had not said to beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
en.B: Then they realized that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was not warning them against the yeast used in bread, but against what the Pharisees and Sadducees taught.
en.R: Then the followers understood. Jesus was not telling them to watch out for yeast in bread. He was warning them about the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

es.L: Entonces entendieron que no [les] había dicho que se cuidaran de la levadura de los panes, sino de la enseñanza de los fariseos y saduceos.
es.B: Entonces comprendieron que no los estaba previniendo contra la levadura que se usa en el pan, sino contra lo que enseñaban los fariseos y saduceos.
es.R: Entonces los seguidores entendieron. Jesús no les estaba diciendo que se cuidaran de la levadura del pan. Les estaba advirtiendo sobre la enseñanza de los fariseos y saduceos.

fr.L: Alors ils comprirent qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’avait pas dit de se garder du levain des pains, mais de l’enseignement des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens.
fr.B: Alors ils comprirent qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne les mettait pas en garde contre le levain du pain, mais contre ce qu’enseignaient les Pharisiens et les Sadducéens.
fr.R: Alors les disciples ont compris. Jésus ne leur disait pas de se méfier du levain qu’on met dans le pain. Il les mettait en garde contre l’enseignement des Pharisiens et des Sadducéens.

sw.L: Kisha wakaelewa kwamba hakuwa amesema wajihadhari na chachu ya mikate, ila na mafundisho ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo.
sw.B: Hapo walitambua kwamba hakuwa akiwaonya juu ya chachu inayotumika katika mkate, bali juu ya yale ambayo Mafarisayo na Masadukayo walifundisha.
sw.R: Kisha wafuasi walielewa. Yesu hakuwa akiwaambia wajihadhari na chachu ya mkate. Alikuwa akiwaonya juu ya mafundisho ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo.

vi.L: Bấy giờ họ hiểu rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không bảo giữ mình khỏi men làm bánh, nhưng khỏi sự dạy dỗ của người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê.
vi.B: Bấy giờ họ mới hiểu rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không cảnh báo họ về men làm bánh, nhưng về những điều người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê dạy dỗ.
vi.R: Bấy giờ các môn đồ mới hiểu. Đức Giê-xu không bảo họ coi chừng men trong bánh. Ngài cảnh báo họ về những lời dạy của người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê.

ko.L: 그제야 그들은 그분이 빵의 누룩을 조심하라고 말씀하신 것이 아니라, 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들의 가르침을 조심하라고 말씀하신 것임을 깨달았다.
ko.B: 그제야 제자들은, 예수께서 빵에 넣는 누룩을 경계하라고 하신 것이 아니라 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들의 가르침을 경계하라고 하신 것임을 깨달았다.
ko.R: 그때에야 제자들은 깨달았다. 예수께서는 빵에 넣는 누룩을 조심하라고 하신 것이 아니었다. 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들이 가르치는 것을 조심하라고 하신 것이었다.

decisions.choice: the teaching: their teaching and way of reading the law
decisions.reason: Jesus has already rejected the Pharisees' traditions (15:1-14). Their teaching, and the Sadducees', kept people from seeing who he was.

decisions.choice: they understood: the disciples come to understand after Jesus explains
decisions.reason: Matthew often shows the disciples understanding once Jesus explains (13:51; 17:13).

decisions.choice: "sự dạy dỗ" (L); "những điều ... dạy dỗ" (B); "những lời dạy" (R)
decisions.reason: Their teaching and their way of reading the law (meaning decision); "giáo lý" would suggest a fixed doctrine.

decisions.choice: "말씀하신 것임을" repeated without brackets
decisions.reason: The Greek "not ... but" shares one verb; Korean must say it in each half, which is grammar, not an added word.
